'''2011 US Nationals Veers DS Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Veers]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V)|V8-D-hothiceplains.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jim
* '''Deck name:''' Walkers Hoth
* '''Username:''' Veers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
